repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.summary_zh: Graphify 将任意代码库（含文档、SQL、PDF、图像、视频）转化为可查询知识图谱，作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 17+ AI 编码助手的 /graphify 技能。本地 tree-sitter AST 确定性解析 36+ 语言代码，无 LLM 且数据不离机；每个边标注 EXTRACTED/INFERRED 确保透明。输出交互式 graph.html、GRAPH_REPORT.md 和 graph.json，支持路径查询、社区检测（Leiden），非向量存储。适用于新项目理解、PR 审查、团队 onboarding，大幅降低 AI token 消耗。
repos.summary_en: Graphify turns any codebase—including code, docs, SQL, configs, PDFs, images, and videos—into a queryable knowledge graph. It installs as a /graphify skill for 17+ AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Code is parsed locally and deterministically via tree-sitter AST across 36+ languages with no LLM or data leaving the machine. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for auditability. It outputs interactive graph.html, a report, and graph.json for path queries, community detection, and concept exploration instead of vector stores or grepping. Ideal for onboarding, codebase navigation, PR reviews, and grounding AI responses with significant token savings.

repos.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repos.summary_zh: Ghidra是NSA开源的软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、图形化分析与脚本扩展能力，支持多平台、多处理器指令集。可用于恶意代码分析、漏洞挖掘与团队协作逆向，支持交互与自动化模式，并允许用Java/Python开发扩展，是高端可定制的SRE研究平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghidra is an open-source software reverse engineering framework by the NSA, offering disassembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports multiple platforms and processor architectures, enabling malware analysis, vulnerability research, and collaborative SRE in both interactive and automated modes, with extensibility via Java or Python.

repos.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Understand Anything 通过多智能体流水线分析代码库，结合 Tree-sitter 结构解析与 LLM 语义理解，构建文件、函数、类及依赖的交互式知识图谱。支持结构视图与业务领域视图切换，提供语义搜索、引导游览、影响分析和多语言支持。兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码工具，帮助开发者快速掌握大型代码库架构与业务逻辑，加速 onboarding 与代码探索。
repos.summary_en: Understand Anything uses a multi-agent pipeline combining tree-sitter parsing and LLMs to turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph of files, functions, classes, and dependencies. It offers structural and business domain views, semantic search, guided tours, and impact analysis. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and more, it helps developers quickly understand complex projects, aiding onboarding and AI-assisted coding.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个专为AI编码代理设计的营销技能集合，以Markdown文件形式提供CRO、文案写作、SEO、数据分析和增长工程等专业工作流。基于Agent Skills规范构建，技能相互引用并以product-marketing为基础，提供产品、受众与定位上下文。适用于Claude Code、Cursor等工具，帮助技术营销者和创始人通过AI代理实现营销任务自动化与优化。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a curated collection of markdown-based skills for AI coding agents, specializing in CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built to the Agent Skills spec, skills interconnect with product-marketing as the foundational layer providing product, audience, and positioning context. It empowers technical marketers and founders using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to automate and optimize marketing workflows efficiently.

repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.summary_zh: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源平价替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、反向链接、站点审计及 AI 可见性等核心 SEO 工作流。通过 MCP 服务器和可复用技能实现与 Claude 等 AI 智能体的深度集成，支持 Docker 或 Cloudflare 自托管，用户自带 DataForSEO API 密钥实现按需付费。界面简洁现代，聚焦高效工作流，适合个人、团队及 AI 驱动的 SEO 策略定制与控制。
repos.summary_en: OpenSEO is an open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, delivering essential SEO workflows including keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits, and AI visibility. It features deep AI agent integration via MCP server and customizable skills for tools like Claude, with self-hosting options (Docker or Cloudflare) and BYO DataForSEO API key for usage-based costs. The modern, focused UI empowers individuals, teams, and AI-powered SEO strategies with full control and customization.

repos.description: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.
repos.summary_zh: Chandra OCR 2 是业界领先的文档智能模型，专精于复杂表格、手写体及数学公式的精准识别。支持90+语言，完美保留原始布局，输出HTML/Markdown/JSON结构化数据。提供本地(HuggingFace)与云端(vLLM)双模式，在手写表单、技术文档等场景表现卓越，是企业级文档自动化的核心引擎。
repos.summary_en: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence model excelling at complex tables, handwriting, and mathematical formulas. Supporting 90+ languages, it preserves full layout fidelity while outputting structured HTML/Markdown/JSON. With dual inference modes (local HuggingFace and remote vLLM), it delivers exceptional performance for forms, technical documents, and multilingual content, serving as a core engine for enterprise document automation.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

repos.description: Claude-first paid-media operations skill for Claude Code across 12 ad platforms (Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, X): source-grounded audits, deterministic findings and evidence coverage, versioned JSON reports, and capability-gated account changes.
repos.summary_zh: 为Claude Code设计的付费广告审计AI技能，覆盖Google、Meta等8大平台，通过250+检查项在10-15分钟内完成原需4-6小时的人工审计。采用加权评分和并行代理技术，提供优先级行动方案与AI创意生成，支持跨平台部署，适用于PPC代理机构、企业内部营销团队及自由顾问。
repos.summary_en: An AI skill for Claude Code that automates paid advertising audits across 8 platforms including Google and Meta. It performs 250+ checks in 10-15 minutes, replacing 4-6 hours of manual work. Features weighted scoring, parallel agents, prioritized action plans, and AI creative generation. Cross-platform compatible for PPC agencies, in-house marketers, and freelance consultants.

repos.description: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world landing page
repos.summary_zh: AI代理技能，能为任何品牌或行业生成滚动驱动的沉浸式3D世界落地页。滚动实现相机连续飞行穿越连贯场景，无剪辑。基于Higgsfield AI生成等距场景与视频，JS引擎驱动，支持移动端。框架无关，适用于品牌营销。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and similar tools that generates immersive scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages for any brand. Scrolling drives continuous camera flights through connected scenes without cuts. Uses Higgsfield AI for isometric scenes and frame-locked videos, with a vanilla JS scrub engine and mobile portrait support. Framework-agnostic for brand marketing.

repos.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
repos.summary_zh: AutoHedge 是一个基于群体智能的多代理AI系统，可自动化构建对冲基金。系统采用Director、Quant、Risk Manager、Execution四层代理架构，实现从市场分析、策略生成到风险控制和交易执行的全流程自主化。目前支持Solana链上全自动交易，采用风险优先设计，提供结构化输出和企业级日志，适用于机构级量化交易场景。
repos.summary_en: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous hedge fund platform powered by swarm intelligence and multi-agent AI systems. It orchestrates specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, risk management, and trade execution in a risk-first pipeline. Currently supporting full autonomous trading on Solana, it features structured JSON outputs, comprehensive logging, and modular architecture for institutional-grade quantitative trading with minimal human intervention.

repos.description: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.
repos.summary_zh: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
repos.summary_en: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: Deep dive into Claude Code internals — architecture, agent loop, context engineering, and more. / 深入解析 Claude Code 源码：架构、Agent 循环、上下文工程、工具系统等
repos.summary_zh: 这个项目深入解析Claude Code的50万行TypeScript源码，揭示其百万级DAU生产系统的架构设计。核心亮点包括：4级渐进式上下文压缩解决token限制，5层纵深防御保障安全执行，工具预执行与全链路流式输出实现极致性能，以及静默恢复机制提升用户体验。适合AI Agent开发者和架构师学习。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a comprehensive analysis of Claude Code's 500,000-line TypeScript source codebase, revealing the engineering architecture powering this leading AI programming agent. It dissects critical production-grade designs: 4-level progressive context compression managing token constraints, 5-layer security system preventing dangerous operations, tool pre-execution with full streaming pipeline for perceived performance, and silent recovery mechanisms with 7 retry strategies. The 12-chapter documentation covers agent loops, context engineering, and tool orchestration, serving as a valuable resource for developers building production AI agents.

repos.description: AI reads books: Page-by-Page PDF Knowledge Extractor & Summarizer. script performs an intelligent page-by-page analysis of PDF books, methodically extracting knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at specified intervals
repos.summary_zh: 该工具通过AI逐页解析PDF书籍，自动提取核心知识点并生成渐进式摘要。支持智能过滤目录/索引页，具备断点续处理与Markdown结构化输出能力。适用于个人深度学习、研究资料整理与知识库构建，实现从海量书籍中高效提炼结构化知识，提升阅读效率与知识内化效果。
repos.summary_en: This tool performs AI-powered page-by-page analysis of PDF books, automatically extracting key knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at configurable intervals. Featuring intelligent filtering of TOC/index pages, resume capability, and structured Markdown output, it maintains contextual flow while processing. Ideal for deep learning, research material processing, and knowledge base construction, it efficiently transforms massive books into structured knowledge, significantly improving reading efficiency and knowledge internalization through systematic analysis.

repos.description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.summary_zh: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
repos.summary_en: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

repos.description: Code for the Molmo2 Vision-Language Model
repos.summary_zh: Molmo2 是艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）开源的视觉-语言模型，在视频理解、点驱动定位与跟踪任务上达到开源 SOTA 水平。支持单图、多图和视频推理，具备长上下文处理能力，提供 Transformers 和 vLLM 高效部署方案，适用于智能分析、视觉交互和自动化决策等场景。
repos.summary_en: Molmo2 is an open vision-language model from the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that achieves state-of-the-art performance in video understanding, point-driven grounding, and tracking among open-source models. It supports single-image, multi-image, and video inference with long-context capabilities. The repository provides comprehensive training/evaluation code, pre-trained checkpoints, and efficient deployment via Transformers and vLLM. Ideal for intelligent visual analysis, interactive grounding, and automated decision-making applications.

repos.description: Local-first, open-source Claude Science alternative, before Claude Science is a thing. Turn your AI agent into personal DNA expert.
repos.summary_zh: Genomi 是开源 AI 代理运行时，将 AI 代理转变为个人 DNA 专家。它提供本地私有工作空间，包括 Active Genome Index 存储变异数据、公共遗传证据查询、探索记忆和报告工具，实现证据支持的 DNA 问题解答。基因组数据完全本地保留，支持 MCP 兼容主机如 Claude，解析原始 DNA 文件，回答健康风险、药物反应、遗传特征等问题，并随研究自更新。保障隐私的个性化基因组分析。
repos.summary_en: Genomi is an open-source AI agent runtime that turns your AI agent into a personal DNA expert. It provides a private local workspace with an Active Genome Index for variants, public genetics evidence queries, exploration memory, and report tools for evidence-backed answers. Genome data stays on-device. Compatible with MCP hosts like Claude, it parses raw DNA files, enables local querying on health risks, medication responses and traits, and self-updates with latest research for secure, personalized genomic insights.

repos.description: 📚 Character relationship maps
repos.summary_zh: Austen是一款AI驱动的文学分析工具，通过集成DeepSeek/OpenAI自动解析书籍角色关系，并生成Mermaid可视化图谱。基于Next.js全栈框架与Supabase后端，支持用户管理、图表保存(SVG/PNG)与社交分享，为教育、阅读及文学研究提供直观的关系探索体验。
repos.summary_en: Austen is an AI-powered literary analysis tool that automatically extracts character relationships from books using DeepSeek/OpenAI and visualizes them via Mermaid diagrams. Built on Next.js fullstack with Supabase backend, it enables user management, graph export (SVG/PNG), and social sharing—ideal for educators, readers, and literary research to visually explore narrative dynamics.

repos.description: List of OSINT Books
repos.summary_zh: 该GitHub仓库精选开源情报（OSINT）书籍列表，聚焦工具与技术、在网络安全、招聘及人权调查等场景的应用，还涵盖调查心理层面。优先收录2020年代出版物，避免过时技术内容，包括批判性思维、AI情报分析、尽职调查、隐私保护等主题。每条目附封面、作者社交链接、年份和购买链接，为情报分析师和安全专业人士提供实用、全面的OSINT学习资源。
repos.summary_en: This GitHub repository curates a list of books on Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), covering tools, techniques, and applications in cybersecurity, recruiting, and human rights investigations, plus psychological aspects. It prioritizes 2020s publications to avoid outdated technical details, including titles on critical thinking, AI for analysts, due diligence, and privacy. Entries feature covers, author links, years, and purchase links, serving as a practical resource for intelligence professionals seeking modern OSINT methodologies.
